{"code": "from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Compute mean change by arm
df_change_by_arm = df_valid_baseline.groupby('arm')['change'].mean().reset_index()
print("Mean change by arm:")
print(df_change_by_arm)

# Test for significant difference in mean change between arms
t_stat, p_val = ttest_ind(
    df_valid_baseline[df_valid_baseline['arm'] == 'control']['change'],
    df_valid_baseline[df_valid_baseline['arm'] == 'treatment']['change'],
    equal_var=False  # Welch's t-test for unequal variances
)

print(f"\nT-statistic: {t_stat:.4f}")
print(f"P-value: {p_val:.4f}")"}
